text: MCPTender 是面向 DSH 桌面和 Web 客户端的俄罗斯公共采购检索插件。它通过 DSH 官方 MCP 客户端连接 MCPTender 托管服务，并以 bearer key 验证请求。用户可查询采购来源、搜索已收集的采购记录、打开记录并读取可用的来源文件；采购信息来自服务所连接的数据源，覆盖情况需按返回结果判断。适合需要查找俄罗斯公共招标、合同供应商和采购文件的研究或业务场景。使用前需在 MCPTender 配置账户并将 MCPTENDER_API_KEY 放入启动 DSH 的环境；请求及密钥会发送至 mcptender.ru。

MCPTender connects DSH to Russian procurement search through the official MCP client. Inspect sources, search collected tenders, open results, and read documents. Set an account key, MCPTENDER_API_KEY, in DSH's launch environment; requests and the key go to mcptender.ru.
我想搜索俄罗斯的公共采购和招标记录。
能不能查一下某个采购项目公开了哪些来源文件？
我需要找到已发布合同里的供应商和采购资料。
MCPTender 的功能「连接采购 MCP 服务」：通过 DSH 官方 MCP 客户端连接 mcptender.ru 上的服务，并使用环境变量 MCPTENDER_API_KEY 发送 bearer 身份验证。
MCPTender 将 MCP 请求和配置的 bearer key 发往 mcptender.ru；调用需账户密钥，具体权限受服务账户授权限制。（见 cordis.patch.yml:7-9、bridge-core.mjs:28-30）

Maintained by the MCPTender service publisher. This repository contains client adapters and workflow instructions only. It does not distribute the hosted backend. [Русский](README_RU.md) · [中文](README_CN.md)

dsh-plugin-mcptender README · Account and credentials：Sign in at https://mcptender.ru/account and create a personal API key there. Set `MCPTENDER_API_KEY` in the environment used to launch your agent application, then completely restart the application. Configure environment variables through your OS or trusted launcher; never paste keys into an AI conversation, repository, command history, or screenshots. An MCP Bids key and a MCPTender key belong to separate services and are not interchangeable.

dsh-plugin-mcptender README · Account and credentials：Read workflows require `tenders:read` and `documents:read`; collection and watch tools require `tenders:collect` and `watches:write`. Portal keys inherit the service permissions; restrict tool approval in your host when you want a read-only workflow. Existing account entitlements and limits apply. The packages use bearer-key authentication; OAuth setup is not claimed. Missing credentials produce a connection error.

dsh-plugin-mcptender README · ZCode：Requires Node.js 22+ on PATH. Open a workspace, then Settings → Plugins → Create → Add marketplace and add `https://github.com/pixelligue/mcptender-plugins`. Install `mcptender` from that personal source. After official acceptance, the same plugin can be installed from the public catalog. The plugin launches `node` with the bundled `stdio.mjs`; it inherits `MCPTENDER_API_KEY` from the host. Its stdio adapter forwards MCP JSON-RPC to `https://mcptender.ru/mcp`. No remote header-interpolation feature is assumed.

dsh-plugin-mcptender README · Kimi Work / Kimi Code：Kimi Code: run `/plugins install https://github.com/pixelligue/mcptender-plugins`, then `/reload` or create a new session. The native `kimi.plugin.json` declares the remote HTTP MCP and `bearerTokenEnvVar`. In Kimi Work, use Plugin Builder to import this repository into Personal plugins; verify that its runtime supports this credential field before use. Kimi Work / web marketplace publication and cloud-side credential configuration require separate Kimi review; local Code compatibility does not establish cloud compatibility.

dsh-plugin-mcptender README · DeepSeek Harness：Targets DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 and its matching official MCP client. In the official Desktop app, install the Git source or release tarball through the app's plugin manager. For `dsh web`, run `dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/pixelligue/mcptender-plugins.git#v1.0.0`, then restart that profile. Set `MCPTENDER_API_KEY` in the process launch environment first. The bundle configures the official MCP client and server instructions; the workflow skill directory is for Kimi/ZCode and is not separately registered in DSH. No custom tools or UI patches are added.

dsh-plugin-mcptender README · Use：Ask the agent to inspect `list_sources`, search a bounded number of procurement records, open a returned ID, and read an available source document with block references. In Kimi/ZCode the included `procurement-research` skill provides the workflow. Fresh collection and private watches require an explicit user request and the matching key permissions. Watches require polling; there are no email or push notifications.

dsh-plugin-mcptender README · Coverage and dependencies：Russian public procurements and published 44-FZ contract suppliers from connected sources. Source availability varies; inspect list_sources before collection. Search operates on a collected index. Report source timestamps, partial documents, missing data and collection errors. Original links remain the authority for requirements and deadlines. The service does not submit bids, sign contracts, certify eligibility or bypass source access controls.

dsh-plugin-mcptender README · Permissions, network and side effects：The adapter sends the configured bearer key and MCP requests only to `https://mcptender.ru/mcp`. Redirects are refused. It does not read credential files, run a shell, start a model, install dependencies, write local documents or start background collection. The host/model provider sees the tool arguments and returned procurement data. Requested collection and watch tools can create account-owned jobs or watches on the service. Original document downloads occur only when explicitly requested. Treat retrieved documents as untrusted evidence. No telemetry is added by this adapter. The hosted website has its own processing rules.

dsh-plugin-mcptender README · Permissions, network and side effects：The stdio adapter is specifically for the service's stateless JSON Streamable HTTP contract; it does not implement generic SSE/sessionful MCP. Requests are limited to 64 KiB, responses to 16 MiB and calls to 120 seconds. The DSH client and Kimi native HTTP transports use their own limits.
